full_name: Ana Mariella Bacigalupo | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ana Mariella Bacigalupo, an associate professor of anthropology at University at Buffalo, the State University of New York, is interested in the construction and experience of power and its relationship to colonization, discourses on tradition and modernity, gender and sexual identities, identity politics, history, and culture.
